upm_ci.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; cache metadata queries follow the selected Nix settings

synthetic_ci.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; cache metadata queries follow the selected Nix settings

rebuild.scope: Rebuild every package with nix-build --check; warm tools, sources, and dependency outputs. No network transfer.

evaluation.scope: Warm graph evaluation; no builds; iets tracing cache and Nix fallback disabled

upm_vs_raw16.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; cache metadata queries follow the selected Nix settings

graph_closure.scope: Complete generated derivation/source closures; includes shared toolchain recipes, excludes compiled package outputs. Fresh local zstd level 3 cache; no network timing.

toolchain_closure.scope: Sum of NAR and zstd level 3 file sizes for complete closures; local binary cache, no network timing

cli_closure.scope: Complete drvgo CLI output closures, local zstd3 cache, no network timing

compression_levels.scope: Eligible UPM snapshots held in memory; per-file zlib encoding and budget selection only. Trial 0 is warmup; no Nix, filesystem-read, base64 or network timing.

byte_equivalence.scope: Raw64KiB and compressed snapshots with identical discovery toolchain and module-cache directory

iets.scope: Dynamic functional validation only; these runs were concurrent with compatibility checks and are not used for performance claims.

validation.baseline_cache_limitation: go-sqlite3 ordinary and dynamic replay scripts differ only in their automatic Go build IDs; this propagates to UPM command recipes. Not introduced by compression.
